title: Pale Fragment: Still Waters
obscured_text: Silver letters lie under a white film. The shapes are clean, but they will not yield.
A chill gathers in the cuts of the stone.
revealed_text: Still Waters is written as refusal before it is written as prayer. The first cleansing asks the body to stop mistaking pain for belonging.
Lethean water does not erase because it hates memory. It silences what keeps biting after the wound should close.
